source.catalogue: VI/81  Planetary Solutions VSOP87 (Bretagnon P., Francou G., 1988)
source.frame: heliocentric spherical (L, B, R); mean dynamical ecliptic and equinox of date
source.term: A * tau**n * cos(B + C * tau); L, B in radians, R in au
source.stated_precision: VSOP87 relative precision p0 for the Earth: 0.6e-8 (about 0.0012 arcsec)

truncation.rule: keep a term when its peak contribution over the coverage window, |A| * tau_abs**n with tau_abs = 0.061001, exceeds the per-variable threshold; thresholds chosen so the sum of the peak contributions of every dropped term (worst case, all in phase) stays inside the budget
